_README: Copy to config/dataset_catalog.json (gitignored) and point the paths at
your own data. This file decides what an analysis request may name, and
it is read server-side only — no path in it ever reaches a browser or a
model, which see only the input_ref and the display name.
Every path here is also checked against CONTROLLER_DATA_ROOTS. An entry
outside the allowed roots is dropped rather than honoured: the catalog
says what is offered, the roots say what is reachable, and a catalog
cannot widen the second.
A relative path is taken relative to the repository root, not the
process's working directory — so 'data/counted/...' means what you would
expect. An absolute path is taken as written. Either way it still has to
sit inside CONTROLLER_DATA_ROOTS.
An entry whose path does not exist, or falls outside the allowed roots,
is refused and named on the /analysis/new page with the reason. It is not
silently dropped: an empty dataset list would otherwise be
indistinguishable from a catalog nobody has filled in yet.
'kind' is a hint for the intake conversation. ingest_validate detects
FASTQ, MTX, .h5 and .h5ad from the filesystem on every run and its answer
decides the route — a wrong 'kind' here misleads a conversation, it does
not misroute an analysis.

pbmc_1k_v3.description: 10x 3' v3, human PBMC. The reference end-to-end run; counting takes about twenty minutes.

pbmc_1k_v3_counted.description: Cell Ranger output for the above. Skips counting; the matrix route starts at matrix_preflight.

neuron_1k_v3.description: 10x 3' v3, mouse brain. A second reference and the cross-species guard.

manifests._README: One row per sequencing library: library_id, sample_id, donor_id, condition, technical_batch. Required before Harmony can run, and before any question about differences between samples.

pbmc_study.description: Example only — replace with a manifest that describes your libraries.
